notes.title: August update
notes.notes:
Another UI update to address some bugs, address some UX issues and, it is just better looking.

Also added a new scene. Lattice. If you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss will gaze back into you... Literally, not figuratively.

notes.title: UI Redesign
notes.notes: The last UI redesign was an improvement, but far from perfect... This latest redesign is much less further away from perfect. The changes were mostly to improve the look of the core controls, but also to tone down some of the "clarity"  changes from last time. As always, let me know what you think in the discussion section.
